title: Yann LeCun's AMI Labs raises $1.03 billion to build world models
summary: AMI Labs (Advanced Machine Intelligence), the AI startup co-founded by Turing Award laureate Yann LeCun, has raised $1.03 billion in a seed round at a $3.5 billion valuation. The company is building world models based on LeCun's JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) framework, which aims to create AI systems that understand the physical world. The round was co-led by Bezos Expeditions, Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, Hiro Capital, and HV Capital.

title: French AI startup AMI announces $1bn raised in funding
summary: French AI startup AMI (Advanced Machine Intelligence) has announced raising over $1 billion in seed funding, making it one of the largest seed rounds in European startup history. Founded by Yann LeCun alongside a team of former Meta FAIR researchers, AMI is developing 'universal intelligent systems' based on world models. The company is headquartered in Paris with offices in New York, Montreal, and Singapore.

title: HIRO Capital co-leads $1.03bn round in Yann LeCun's Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI) at a $3.5bn valuation
summary: Hiro Capital has announced co-leading a $1.03 billion seed round in Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI Labs) alongside Bezos Expeditions, Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, and HV Capital. AMI is focused on Physical AI and world models — areas that align closely with Hiro Capital's investment thesis around spatial computing and physical intelligence.

title: Former Meta A.I. Chief's Start-Up Is Valued at $3.5 Billion
summary: AMI Labs, the AI startup led by Yann LeCun — who served as Meta's Chief AI Scientist for over a decade — has been valued at $3.5 billion after closing a $1.03 billion seed round. The funding underscores continued investor appetite for foundational AI research, particularly approaches that diverge from the dominant large language model paradigm championed by OpenAI and Google.

title: Yann LeCun's AMI Labs secures $1B+ in bet on world models
summary: AMI Labs has secured over $1 billion in seed funding, with notable angel investors including Jeff Bezos, Eric Schmidt, Mark Cuban, Xavier Niel, Tim Berners-Lee, and Jim Breyer participating alongside institutional investors. The company's approach centers on JEPA-based world models as an alternative path to artificial general intelligence, with a 13-person founding team drawn predominantly from Meta's Fundamental AI Research (FAIR) lab.

title: Ex-Meta AI chief Yann LeCun's AMI raises $1.03 billion as alternative AI approach
summary: Channel News Asia reports that AMI Labs, led by former Meta Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun, has raised $1.03 billion to advance its alternative approach to AI development centred on world models and the JEPA architecture, positioning itself as a counterpoint to mainstream large language model-based AI systems.

title: Building Intelligent AI Systems that Understand the Real World: Our Investment in AMI Labs
summary: Toyota Ventures has published a blog post explaining its strategic investment in AMI Labs, noting that the company's physical AI and world model research directly aligns with Toyota's vision for next-generation automotive and robotics intelligence. Toyota Ventures sees AMI's JEPA architecture as a promising foundation for AI systems that must reason about the physical world.
